action for the modelling team: Use log(price) or the ordinal price_band; never raw price in a distance metric
Normalise price fit within category, not globally
Macro-average all metrics; apply class weights; cap results per category
Multiply every occasion match by its inverse-frequency weight

finding: Occasion labels are rule-derived, not observed
action for the modelling team: Do not train a model on them and evaluate against them; that is circular
Exclude it from text features; embed product_name instead
Use a multilingual encoder and fold Arabic letter variants

finding: source_site correlates with category and price
action for the modelling team: Exclude source_site as a model feature; keep it for bias reporting only

finding: Age-gender and category-budget grids contain thin cells
action for the modelling team: Evaluate per cell; relax category on fallback, never budget or age

finding: Sub-category is unverifiable for many products
action for the modelling team: Use subcategory_confidence to demote, never to delete or relabel

finding: A share of products has no image
action for the modelling team: Read image_display_url only; demote placeholder products in ranking

finding: Products group into parent and options
action for the modelling team: Rank parent products; resolve options at the interface layer
